Closes TD-008 (first-row insert race, closed by DS-020 leveraging the DS-015 advisory-lock pattern shipped in S2).

new_decisions.topic: V2 auth login wire format is OAuth2 form-encoded (application/x-www-form-urlencoded) per DS-018 + RFC 6749 §4.3.2. TC-208/TC-209 body field is a semantic payload description; Phase 3 test-impl will encode via httpx data=. LLD line 236 (`data: LoginRequest`) is documentation drift.

V2 non-auth routers rely on route-level Depends(get_current_user) declared inside each router file, NOT on mount-level dependencies=[Depends(get_current_user)] in main.py. Behaviorally equivalent under FastAPI Depends dedup; TC-213 unaffected. Intent is inline-documented on main.py:64 and 68-69.
